name: Writing and Authorship
description: Roles for producing written work: a content strategist advisor, an author, and an independent editor.

roles.label: Content Strategist
roles.description: Advises on audience, structure, and message without writing the deliverable.
responsibilities: Define audience, purpose, and structure for the piece
Flag gaps between the brief and the proposed outline

roles.label: Author
roles.description: Writes the assigned piece within an isolated worktree.
responsibilities: Draft the assigned piece to the brief and acceptance criteria
Revise in response to editorial review
Escalate unclear scope or missing source material

roles.label: Editor
roles.description: Independently reviews a completed piece for accuracy, clarity, and fit to the brief.
responsibilities: Check the piece against the brief and acceptance criteria
Report an explicit approve or reject decision with specific edits
